scope: Rotational equivariance; translation is not compared. Up-only yaw is unspecified.
accuracy_note: Agreement can be consistently wrong; reference accuracy is reported separately.
history: First rotation per object reuses the previously saved decision; four remaining rotations are new decisions by the same interactive agent with prior session context. This is not an independent blinded model evaluation.

protocol.comparison: Compare selected rotations in a common source frame; ignore yaw for up-only categories; report abstention separately.
